entries.text: Hello, hello. My name’s Jacq, and I’ll be your\nPokémon biology teacher.[VAR 0x0114(002A)]
entries.label: class_a_01_ecology_01

entries.text: In my class, we’ll all learn about the various\nquirks of our beloved Pokémon together![VAR 0x0114(002A)]
entries.label: class_a_01_ecology_02

entries.text: I hope you all come to love Pokémon even more\nfrom the things you learn here.[VAR 0x0114(002A)]
entries.label: class_a_01_ecology_03

entries.text: In today’s class, I’ll teach you a great way to\nget to know Pokémon in more depth.[VAR 0x0114(002A)]
entries.label: class_a_01_ecology_04

entries.text: If you’d like to become better friends with your\nPokémon...[VAR 0x0114(002A)]
entries.label: class_a_01_ecology_05

entries.text: you can let them come out of their Poké Ball\nand walk along with you! Sounds great, huh?[VAR 0x0114(002A)]
entries.label: class_a_01_ecology_06

entries.text:
You can use the [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]ZR Button[VAR 0xFF00(0000)] to throw a Poké Ball
and let out the Pokémon inside.\c
Nothing cuter than watching your Pokémon run
around underfoot, if you ask me.[VAR 0x0114(002A)]
entries.label: class_a_01_ecology_07

entries.text: Once you let your Pokémon out, try speaking to\nthem—they’re sure to respond in some way.\r\nIt’s a great way to get to know them better![VAR 0x0114(002A)]
entries.label: class_a_01_ecology_08

entries.text:
However! Letting your Pokémon out of its ball
isn’t such a great idea in some locations.\c
Can anyone tell me where it is that you shouldn’t
have your Pokémon walk along with you?[VAR 0x0114(002A)]
entries.label: class_a_01_ecology_09

entries.text: Near the water
entries.label: class_a_01_select_01

entries.text: Inside buildings
entries.label: class_a_01_select_02

entries.text: In tall grass
entries.label: class_a_01_select_03

entries.text: It’s certainly true that some Pokémon aren’t fond\nof water, but we do have floating platforms they\r\ncan use, so being near water isn’t an issue.[VAR 0x0114(002A)]
entries.label: class_a_01_ecology_answer_01

entries.text:
[VAR 0xBD06(0000)]That’s right! Great job, [VAR 0x0100(0000)].
I see
you
did
your
homework.[VAR 0x0114(002A)]
entries.label: class_a_01_ecology_answer_02

entries.text: Pokémon love tall grass! I can’t see them having\nany problem walking with you there.[VAR 0x0114(002A)]
entries.label: class_a_01_ecology_answer_03

entries.text: The correct answer is that we should not walk\nwith our Pokémon indoors. How about that![VAR 0x0114(002A)]
entries.label: class_a_01_ecology_10

entries.text: Some Pokémon might damage walls, desks, and\nother things walking around inside buildings, so\r\nit’s not allowed regardless of the species.[VAR 0x0114(002A)]
entries.label: class_a_01_ecology_11

entries.text:
Therefore, please only let your Pokémon out of
their Poké Balls while outdoors. OK, everyone?\c
I think I see them out and about in classrooms
from time to time, but still...[VAR 0x0114(002A)]
entries.label: class_a_01_ecology_12

entries.text: Anyway, you may become even closer friends\nwith your Pokémon pals by walking together![VAR 0x0114(002A)]
entries.label: class_a_01_ecology_13

entries.text: Oh! I almost forgot—keep in mind that you can\nonly walk together with your lead Pokémon.[VAR 0x0114(002A)]
entries.label: class_a_01_ecology_14

entries.text:
Remember—use the [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]ZR Button[VAR 0xFF00(0000)] to throw a ball
and let out the Pokémon inside.\c
You’ll also want to remember that throwing a
ball at a wild Pokémon will start a battle![VAR 0x0114(002A)]
entries.label: class_a_01_ecology_15

entries.text: It looks like that’s all the time we have for today.\nSee you all next class![VAR 0x0114(002A)]
entries.label: class_a_01_ecology_16
